metaDescription: Indicative pricing for vermiculite removal in Gatineau, Ottawa and Quebec City, with pricing factors, inclusions and site logistics.

hero.title: Vermiculite removal pricing
hero.body: We do not publish firm vermiculite prices. As a practical benchmark, a project may often fall between $8 and $25 / sq ft, but the real range depends on complexity, volume, access and the level of precaution required.

overview.title: Why pricing varies so much
overview.body: A vermiculite file can range from an accessible attic with a clearly defined scope to a more complex project involving cavities, additional protections, restricted access and sampling coordination. Pricing mainly reflects the logistics and control level required.

pricing.title: Reference range
pricing.intro: For vermiculite, we prefer to speak in terms of a reference range rather than fixed public pricing. The real cost can move up or down depending on scope, access and the protection measures required.

cards.title: General range we may see
details: General benchmark only, not a firm posted rate
Can vary significantly based on volume, access and containment
Always confirmed after reading the actual site conditions

cards.title: Simple to moderate project
details: More straightforward access and clearer scope
Containment and protections adapted to the file

cards.title: More complex project
details: Large volume, several areas or difficult access
Higher risk level or additional coordination
Scope to be confirmed after inspection and validation

notes: The $8 to $25 / sq ft range is meant only to help position a project before a more precise review.
Final pricing varies based on actual volume, vermiculite location, access, required protections and coordination needs.

items.title: Volume and location
items.body: The quantity of vermiculite and whether it is in an attic, wall, ceiling or cavity strongly affects the scope of work.

items.title: Access and protections
items.body: Tight access, an occupied building, ventilation to protect or a higher containment requirement can increase pricing.

items.title: Diagnosis coordination
items.body: Some files require the removal plan to be coordinated with sampling, inspection or other validation before moving forward.

included.title: What may be included depending on the file
items: Reading of the scope and required level of precaution
Protection and preparation of the site
Containment or control measures based on the situation
Removal of vermiculite according to the confirmed scope
Handling of removed materials and final cleanup

cta.title: Need to frame your budget?
cta.body: Send us photos of the attic or target area, along with the address and project context. We can better position the likely removal scope.
